queue.title: Model misspecification transfer
queue.finding: The supported linear-benchmark width-2 advantage did not transfer under nonlinear additive ground truth with unchanged linear-Gaussian inference; primary paired edge-error delta was +0.149 with CI [-0.140,+0.476].

queue.title: Nonlinear-aware inference recovery
queue.hypothesis: The nonlinear transfer failure is primarily caused by world-model misspecification rather than proposal breadth; enriching local structural likelihoods with nonlinear parent features should restore absolute recovery and may recover the width-2 breadth advantage.
queue.design: Use the same nonlinear additive five-node worlds and paired width1/width2 controller comparison, but replace linear-only local regressions with a nonlinear-aware local likelihood using both raw-parent and tanh(parent) features with complexity penalty. Screen n=12 then power to n=48 if directionally promising.
secondary_metrics: absolute recovery vs J1 linear-only inference

queue.title: Hidden-confounder transfer
queue.hypothesis: Breadth and robust inference remain useful when observational dependencies include a latent common cause absent from the DAG hypothesis space.

queue.title: Imperfect-intervention transfer
queue.hypothesis: Proposal breadth remains useful when interventions are soft or noisy rather than perfect do-operations.

queue.title: Nonstationary transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller with explicit model-uncertainty handling degrades less when mechanisms drift during the experiment trajectory.

established_findings: Unconditional two-step search does not improve the primary metric after RNG isolation and costs roughly 9x compute.
Initial-state and local-margin depth gates failed to justify deeper search.
Uniform width-2 proposal breadth improves edge recovery over width-1 across combined n=72 matched worlds, with bootstrap CI excluding zero, at roughly 2x compute.
The width-2 gain is a portfolio effect rather than one globally best extra role.
Simple adaptive breadth thresholds failed strict preregistered validation; uniform width-2 remains the supported benchmark controller.
The width-2 advantage does not transfer automatically to nonlinear additive mechanisms when inference remains linear-Gaussian; model misspecification dominates the breadth gain.
dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
